translations.web: After three days they found him in the temple, sitting in the middle of the teachers, both listening to them, and asking them questions.
translations.bsb: Finally, after three days they found Him in the temple courts, sitting among the teachers, listening to them and asking them questions.
translations.kjv: And it came to pass, that after three days they found him in the temple, sitting in the midst of the doctors, both hearing them, and asking them questions.
translations.asv: And it came to pass, after three days they found him in the temple, sitting in the midst of the teachers, both hearing them, and asking them questions:
